tagline: One place for every Luckee coding convention: apps read snapshots through the dispatcher and send change requests instead of editing rules.
summary: Conventions Manager is the single source of truth for how Luckee apps are structured, named and filed: data models, APIs, web, mobile, auth and security. These rules are moving here out of Code Control. Code Control (building), coding-review-agents (reviewing) and Luckee Hub (checking existing projects) all read the same conventions from one place.

Consumers fetch a **snapshot**: the rendered active conventions for one domain and role, with a content hash. Each fetch is recorded. Outside apps never edit conventions. They submit **change requests**, which this app's agent reviews and gives a verdict on (new, refines, conflicts, duplicate, wrong scope). It also publishes versioned markdown and JSON documents (ADRs, cursor rules) that projects keep in their repos. Status: the data model is designed (v2) and is being delivered through Code Control; all five repos are still starter templates.
audience: You build or review Luckee projects and want one set of rules behind Code Control, the review agents and the repo docs.
You run the studio stack: the main gateway on port 3010 and project dispatchers.
notFor: Software systems, repos, template repos or template PRs. Code Control keeps those.
Review agents and review findings. coding-review-agents keeps those.
Checking which document version each project has. Luckee Hub does that.

capabilities.title: Conventions
capabilities.detail: Domains, topics, roles, severity, checks, examples and sources. Conventions are deprecated, never deleted (planned).

capabilities.title: Snapshots over the dispatcher
capabilities.detail: Other apps read the active conventions for a domain and role through the main gateway. Every fetch is logged with the consumer and its record id (planned).

capabilities.title: Change requests
capabilities.detail: Code Control, coding-review-agents or a person submits a request; the agent reviews it and you can override the verdict (planned).

capabilities.title: Change log
capabilities.detail: Every change records its before and after values, reason, origin and source app, including history imported from Code Control (planned).

capabilities.title: Versioned documents
capabilities.detail: ADR markdown, cursor rules and JSON convention files, versioned with content hashes for Luckee Hub to compare (planned).

components.name: Storage server
components.runsOn: The machine with the `conventions_manager` database (Hub port 3104)
components.doesNotOwn: HTTP for browsers or the agent.

components.name: API
components.owns: Convention, snapshot, change request and document routes (`/api/data/*`), and the review agent.
components.doesNotOwn: SQL. It calls storage's `invoke` directly or through the gateway.

components.name: Web app
components.owns: Browsing conventions, reviewing change requests and overriding verdicts, viewing documents and the change log.

components.name: Project dispatcher
components.runsOn: Studio (Hub port 3107; Code Control assigns the gateway ports)
components.owns: Being spawned by the main gateway, spawning storage and the API, and proxying only the endpoints in `dispatcher_exposed_endpoints`.

components.name: Dispatcher console
components.owns: Viewing the dispatcher's services and exposed endpoints.

dataFlow: Before Code Control generates code, it fetches a snapshot for the domain and role through the main gateway and this project's dispatcher.
coding-review-agents and Code Control submit change requests; the agent reviews them, and accepted requests become logged convention changes and new snapshots.
Changes publish new document versions, which Luckee Hub compares with each project's repo.

trust.title: Other apps
trust.detail: Reach the API only through the main gateway and the project dispatcher, limited to the exposed endpoints.

trust.title: Agent
trust.detail: Gives verdicts on change requests; you can override any verdict.

commonTasks.title: Build the first version
commonTasks.when: The repos are still starter templates.
steps: In Code Control, approve the conventions-manager data model (v2).
Press Build all on the software system page and merge any PRs it pauses on.
Update this registry entry's `migrationFiles` and `expectedTables` with the delivered migrations.

troubleshooting.fix: The registry lists only the template migrations until Code Control delivers the data model.

glossary.definition: The rendered active conventions for one domain and role, identified by its content hash.
A proposed new or changed convention from another app or a person. Only this app turns it into a change.
A kind of codebase a convention applies to: storage, express, web, mobile.

hubNotes: All five repos are still starter templates, so Run only gives you health endpoints and blank pages.
Repos live at `~/github/conventions-manager/`, outside the `luckee/` folder.
Hub ports (3104–3108) are for local runs. On the studio, Code Control's dispatcher plan assigns the gateway ports (3200+ block).
